rationale: The original context from MAA/RN/2025/04 (effective 10 October 2025) directly supports all elements of the claim. Paragraph 6 states that for Certified Air Systems, applicants should raise a Military Certification Review Item (MCRI) for MAA agreement. Paragraph 7 explicitly recommends that early applications of ML techniques use training methods such as supervised learning to generate models that remain fixed for integration and use within a defined operational design domain (ODD). The stated scope correctly bounds this as UK military guidance rather than civil airworthiness approval.
evidence_locators: MAA/RN/2025/04, p. 2, Certified Air Systems, paras. 6–7
limitations: The notice constitutes informative military guidance and regulatory position for the UK Defence Air Environment; individual MCRIs and certification agreements remain applicant-specific and non-public.
